title: Global fossil fuel emissions set to fall in 2026, but total CO2 keeps rising
caption:
Fossil fuel emissions are projected to dip in 2026, but it isn't enough to stop total CO2 from rising. Learn why deforestation is keeping the trend moving in the wrong direction.

Source: Sciencedaily - Global fossil fuel emissions set to fall in 2026, but total CO2 keeps rising

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261109205358.htm
